$$
\frac{∂f}{∂x}=-\frac{{e}^{-x}}{y},\,\frac{∂f}{∂y}=-\frac{{e}^{-x}}{{y}^{2}},
$$

find the set of values $(x,y)$ where all partial derivatives of $f$ exist.

Question 6

Given that f(x,y)=e−xy and ∂f∂x=−e−xy,∂f∂y=−e−xy2, find the set of values (x,y) where all partial derivatives of f exist.

a
 {(x,y):y≠0andx≥0}
b
 {(x,y):y≥0}
c
 {(x,y):y≠0}
d
 {(x,y):y>0}
e
 {(x,y):y>0andx>0}
